# EvButtonGroup

> Group related action buttons horizontally so they share borders and read as one control.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:button-group` |
| Layer | Molecule (`src/molecules`) |
| Import | `import { EvButtonGroup } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvButtonGroup>` or `<ev-button-group>` |
| Source | `src/molecules/button-group/EvButtonGroup.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<div class="ev-button-group">` |

## Example

```vue
<EvButtonGroup>
  <EvButtonGroupItem active>Harian</EvButtonGroupItem>
  <EvButtonGroupItem>Mingguan</EvButtonGroupItem>
  <EvButtonGroupItem>Bulanan</EvButtonGroupItem>
</EvButtonGroup>
```

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Button Group**, frame `4187:64907` (Button Group). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Present a short, fixed set of related choices or page numbers as one connected control — pagination, view toggles, segmented filters.

### When not to use

- A single action → use Button (`evoq-ui:button`). Many pages (>9) → use Pagination with ellipsis. Unrelated actions that shouldn't read as one control.

### Do

- Keep the count small and labels short. Group only related items. Mark the active item as selected. Use 9+ for ranges beyond nine.

### Don't

- Don't mix unrelated actions in one group. Don't exceed nine items — use the 9+ overflow. Don't use it for a page's primary action.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvButtonGroup`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root `<div class="ev-button-group">`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:button-group` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
